import os
import warnings
import sys
import string
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMIT_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

STOPWORDS = {
    "the", "a", "an", "and", "or", "but", "in", "on", "at", "to", "for", 
    "of", "is", "was", "are", "been", "be", "have", "has", "had", "do", 
    "does", "did", "will", "would", "could", "should", "may", "might", 
    "must", "need", "all", "any", "each", "few", "more", "most", "other", 
    "some", "such", "no", "nor", "not", "only", "own", "same", "so", 
    "than", "too", "very", "just", "can", "i", "it", "its", "he", "she", 
    "they", "we", "your", "him", "her", "my", "us", "our", "what", "which", 
    "when", "where", "why", "how", "this", "that", "these", "those", "if", 
    "their", "here", "there", "then", "as", "by", "from", "with", "after", 
    "before", "about", "into", "through", "during", "above", "below", 
    "between", "under", "over", "onto", "without", "against", "er", 
    "ed", "est", "s", "re", "ing", "n't", "t", "d", "ve", "ll", "'s", 
    "n't", "am", "o", "l", "c", "m", "u", "y", "p", "g", "b", "h", "f", 
    "j", "k", "v", "w", "z", "q", "x", "$", "@", "#", "%", "&", "*", 
    "^", "?", "!", "(", ")", "[", "]", "{", "}", "~", "`", "|", ";", "=", 
    ":", "-", "+", "'", "/", "\\", "\\"", "<", ">", ".", ","
}


def calculate_log_loss(y_true_labels, y_probs, num_classes=3):
    eps = 1e-15
    total_loss = 0.0

    for i in range(len(y_true_labels)):
        probs = y_probs[i]
        true_class = y_true_labels[i]
        classes_list = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

        true_one_hot = np.zeros(num_classes)
        true_idx = classes_list.index(true_class)
        true_one_hot[true_idx] = 1.0

        for j in range(num_classes):
            p_clamped = max(min(probs[j], 1 - eps), eps)
            total_loss += true_one_hot[j] * np.log(p_clamped)

    return -(total_loss / len(y_true_labels))


def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    clean_text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", text_lower)
    words = clean_text.split()
    filtered_words = [w for w in words if w not in STOPWORDS]
    filtered_text = " ".join(filtered_words)
    filtered_text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", filtered_text).strip()
    return filtered_text


print("Loading datasets...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

train_text = train_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text).fillna("")
test_text = test_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text).fillna("")

word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
word_features = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_text)
test_word_features = word_vectorizer.transform(test_text)

# Changed to analyzer='char' to capture cross-word character n-grams
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_text)
test_char_features = char_vectorizer.transform(test_text)

X_train_full = np.hstack([char_features.toarray(), word_features.toarray()])
y_train_full = train_df["author"].str.upper().values
X_val_full = np.hstack([test_char_features.toarray(), test_word_features.toarray()])
X_test_full = np.hstack([test_char_features.toarray(), test_word_features.toarray()])

unique_authors = np.unique(y_train_full)
classes_list = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]
assert set(unique_authors).issubset(set(classes_list)), "Unexpected labels!"

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

model = MultinomialNB(alpha=0.1, fit_prior=False)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

print("\n--- Training complete ---")

val_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_log_loss = calculate_log_loss(y_val, val_pred_prob)
print(f"\nHold-out Validation Log Loss: {val_log_loss:.6f}")

test_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test_full)

submit_cols = list(sample_df.columns)
num_samples = len(sample_df)
if len(test_df) != num_samples:
    print(f"Warning: Test rows ({len(test_df)}) don't match sample ({num_samples})!")

submit_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": test_df["id"].values,
    "EAP": test_pred_prob[:, 0].astype(float),
    "HPL": test_pred_prob[:, 1].astype(float),
    "MWS": test_pred_prob[:, 2].astype(float),
})

submit_df.to_csv(SUBMIT_PATH, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMIT_PATH} with {len(submit_df)} rows")

verify_sub = pd.read_csv(SUBMIT_PATH)
print(f"Verified submission has {len(verify_sub)} rows and columns: {list(verify_sub.columns)}")

print("Task completed successfully.")
